## What Makes a Role Attractive for This Team

The 19 postings in our filtered dataset do not represent equally strong opportunities for this team. Some of these postings require skills the team has already demonstrated, some are more attainable given their experience requirements, and some originate from employers that are hiring repeatedly for comparable roles. This section converts those factors into a structured scorecard, allowing postings to be compared against one another rather than evaluated individually.

We scored each job posting on three areas we have full or near-full data across these 19 postings:

- **Skill fit**: how many of the role's listed skills overlap with skills our team already rates itself strong in (Data Analysis, Microsoft Excel, Stakeholder Management, and Project Management based on our skill gap findings).
- **Accessibility**: how attainable the role is based on minimum years of experience required. A role asking for 0 years scores highest and the score drops as the experience requirement climbs.
- **Employer signal**: how many postings from that same employer appear in our dataset as a rough proxy for how actively that company is hiring for this kind of role.

We left salary and remote status out of the combined score as only 4 of the 19 postings have that data. Folding these sparse fields into the score would unfairly penalize postings that did not report them. We call those out separately below instead.

The scorecard itself, the methodology behind it, and what the results show are covered on the [Final Analytics](final_analytics.qmd) page.
